method: Same selection system as live play: random subjects and formats, then random unseen questions. Recent subjects are avoided to keep the mix varied; first 100.

questions.prompt: Name a river, lake, sea, ocean, gulf, bay or strait.
Name a driver who has competed in Formula One.
questions.scope: Drivers in the complete Jolpica/Ergast Formula One World Championship driver inventory count, including historical entrants and the Indianapolis 500 when it was part of that championship. A real surname can identify a valid driver; invented initials and racing three-letter codes do not count as names.

questions.prompt: Name a web browser.
questions.scope: Actual web-browser products and families count, including historical, mobile and text browsers. A search engine, rendering engine, extension, website or operating system alone is not a browser.

questions.prompt: Name a dish made mainly from potatoes.
questions.scope: Named dishes count when potato is a main ingredient rather than a garnish.

questions.prompt: Name a playable hero in Dota 2.
questions.scope: The complete official playable hero roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts. Items, cosmetics and non-playable creeps are not heroes.

questions.prompt: Name a type of musical instrument. Named instrument families count.
Name a piece of camping equipment.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a real named canal.
questions.scope: Named canals, shipping channels and recognized artificial waterways count worldwide, including disused historical ones. Natural rivers are not automatically canals.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of animal that can regrow a lost body part.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a named vehicle from fiction.
questions.scope: Named fictional vehicles, ships and vehicle models count across film, TV, books, comics and games, including living vehicle characters. Generic words such as car or spaceship, and individual parts that are not vehicles, do not count.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played in the WNBA.
Name an item or block a furnace recipe can produce in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Give the output, rather than the input, of an ordinary furnace smelting or cooking recipe. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a stew or a named stew dish.
questions.scope: Named stews, braised one-pot dishes and recognized ingredient-based stew styles count. Soups that are also conventionally served as stews count; a raw ingredient, drink or dry standalone food does not.

questions.prompt: Name an item used in a bathroom.
questions.scope: Established bathroom, bathing, grooming and hygiene items count.

questions.prompt: Name a volcano or named volcanic complex. Dormant and extinct ones count.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a plant people eat.
questions.scope: Named edible plants count, including those eaten for fruit, leaves, roots or seeds; fungi are separate.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with pop music.
Name something that produces visible light.
questions.scope: Natural sources and human-made devices count; a reflector alone does not.

questions.prompt: Name a video game where the player can go fishing.
questions.scope: A player-controlled fishing activity counts, including optional minigames.

questions.prompt: Name a named dish or preparation in which eggs are a main ingredient.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has won the NBA regular-season MVP award.
questions.scope: Winners of the main NBA regular-season Most Valuable Player award through the 2025–26 season count. Finals, All-Star and other leagues' MVP awards are different.

questions.prompt: Name a fantasy movie.
Name an item or product used to wash, dry or care for laundry.
questions.scope: Laundry appliances, supplies, stain treatments and clothes-care tools count, as do named product types and established laundry-product brands, including historical ones. A garment itself is not a laundry supply.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of owl.
questions.scope: Owl species and established named groups count, including recently extinct species in the source taxonomy. Common names and scientific names count. An owlet-nightjar or a nighthawk is not an owl.

questions.prompt: Name a food named after a place.
questions.scope: The place name must appear in an established food or dish name.

questions.prompt: Name a champion in League of Legends.
questions.scope: Base-game and recorded expansion names count. Versions of the same named object count once.

questions.prompt: Name a real DJ or DJ act, past or present.
questions.scope: Real DJs and billed DJ duos or groups count, including people known for presenting recorded music on radio. Being a singer or producer alone does not make someone a DJ. Fictional story DJs and unrelated musical groups do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a seasoning, including herbs, spices and named spice blends.
Name a film actor or actress.
Name an object that commonly has a hinge.
questions.scope: A common hinged version of the object must exist. Sliding or roll-up versions do not prevent a genuinely hinged object from counting.

questions.prompt: Name an insect.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a real, named bridge.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Multiplayer”.
Name a rapper, past or present.
questions.scope: Released professional hip-hop artists count; established stage names would be aliases.

questions.prompt: Name a mineral or other natural material used as a gemstone.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a named salad or established salad variety.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a social event or gathering.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a player position in a team sport.
questions.scope: Named playing positions from any established team sport count; shared names are one answer.

questions.prompt: Name an anime TV or streaming show.
Name an animal that lays eggs.
questions.scope: Named animal groups and species qualify; males do not have to lay the eggs themselves.

questions.prompt: Name a real mountain range.
questions.scope: Named ranges, chains, mountain systems and subranges count, anywhere in the world. A single peak by itself is not a range.

questions.prompt: Name a percussion instrument.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a weapon or grenade in Counter-Strike 2. Knife types count.
questions.scope: Base weapons, explosives and knife models count; cosmetic finishes, gloves and healing items do not.

questions.prompt: Name something people can borrow from a public library.
questions.scope: Items must actually be offered by a public library somewhere; Library of Things collections count.

questions.prompt: Name a water sport or recreational activity on or in water.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a named dish commonly made with chicken.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a movie or TV character with superpowers.
questions.scope: A named character must have a supernatural or superhuman ability in the story.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of animal that can pollinate flowers.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a human muscle or muscle group.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a spoken, signed or constructed language.
Name an artist associated with country music.
Name a type of footwear.
Name an item that can be used as furnace fuel in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Items actually accepted in the fuel slot count, rather than anything that merely looks flammable. Their fuel value need not be the same. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name an animation movie.
Name a sport or recognized sporting discipline played on snow or ice.
questions.scope: Established ice and snow sports and competitive disciplines count. A sport merely played during the winter on an ordinary indoor court does not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a type of tree.
Name one of the 88 official constellations.
questions.scope: Official IAU constellation names count. Recognized common names such as Capricorn and the Great Bear are accepted. Asterisms such as the Big Dipper are only parts of constellations.

questions.prompt: Name a named breakfast food or breakfast dish.
questions.scope: Named breakfast foods and dishes from any country count; plain beverages are separate.

questions.prompt: Name a landmark people can visit.
questions.scope: Named natural or human-made visitor landmarks count, including ruins.

questions.prompt: Name a playable hero in Overwatch.
questions.scope: The full official Overwatch roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts, including heroes introduced while it was called Overwatch 2. Skins and unplayable story characters do not.

questions.prompt: Name a song with a person's name in its title.
questions.scope: Released songs count; the name can be a real person or a fictional person.

questions.prompt: Name a type of sports equipment.
Name a hand tool or utensil used to prepare or serve food.
questions.scope: Kitchen hand tools, utensils, serving implements and nonpowered cookware count. Small measuring tools used in food preparation also count. Large powered appliances and foods do not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of parrot.
questions.scope: Parrot species and established named groups count, including recently extinct species in the source taxonomy. Common and scientific names count. Pet colour mutations share their species identity; a bird is not a parrot just because its name contains that word.

questions.prompt: Name a heist movie.
questions.scope: Films built around a robbery, theft, con or organized caper count, including comedies, animated movies and shorts. Television series, directors and a film with only an unrelated passing theft do not automatically count.

questions.prompt: Name something people use to measure things.
questions.scope: Named measuring instruments count; the quantity being measured can be distance, time, temperature or something else.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of flatbread.
questions.scope: Recognized flatbread types, named regional breads and flatbread dishes count, including leavened and unleavened types. Ordinary sandwich loaves, toppings and ingredients alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name something you can craft using wood, planks or sticks in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Any vanilla recipe that directly uses a log, plank or stick counts.

questions.prompt: Name a piece of equipment an athlete wears.
questions.scope: Protective gear, specialist footwear and worn sporting equipment count; handheld equipment does not.

questions.prompt: Name a tool or piece of equipment used for gardening.
questions.scope: Tools, devices and durable equipment used to plant, water, prune, move soil or maintain gardens count. Plant names are not tools.

questions.prompt: Name a landform, natural feature or kind of landscape.
Name a movie with scenes set in outer space.
questions.scope: Some of the story must take place beyond Earth's atmosphere.

questions.prompt: Name a tool, instrument or piece of glassware used in a science laboratory.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a cat breed, including experimental and historical breeds.
Name a game on Steam tagged “Sports”.
Name a pasta shape.
questions.scope: Named pasta shapes count; sauces and full dishes are separate.

questions.prompt: Name a musician known for playing drums.
questions.scope: Real musicians known for playing drums count, including multi-instrumentalists and percussionists with a documented drum-playing career. An unrelated band member does not become a drummer just because the band has one.

questions.prompt: Name a sport or event that has appeared at the modern Olympics.
questions.scope: Summer and Winter Games count, including discontinued events.

questions.prompt: Name a government-issued currency, monetary unit or named historical coin.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a mystery TV or streaming show.
Name a kind of penguin.
questions.scope: Species in the eBird/Clements penguin order and established common group names count. English or scientific names count. Puffins and auks are different kinds of bird.

questions.prompt: Name a flower or flowering block found in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Flower items and blocks count, including tall flowers and Nether-compatible flowers. Named crops and saplings do not become flowers merely because they are plants. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a cloud type, form or recognized cloud feature.
questions.scope: Cloud genera, species, varieties and recognized cloud features count, along with established common names such as lenticular cloud, contrail and fog at ground level. Weather events, precipitation and a blue sky alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a musical genre or subgenre.
Name a sport or competitive game.
Name a real museum.
questions.scope: Named museums and museum complexes count, including historical institutions. Multiple institutions with the same name share an answer identity. A type of museum or a fictional museum is not a named real institution.

questions.prompt: Name a pancake style or a named pancake dish.
questions.scope: Recognized sweet and savory pancake styles and named pancake dishes count, including potato pancakes and international griddle-batter breads. A topping alone, an unrelated pastry, or simply the category word pancake does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of animal that has a protective shell, carapace, bony plates or body armour.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a video game where you can play as an animal.
questions.scope: Animal protagonists and selectable animal characters count; fictional animal species count.

questions.prompt: Name a material or substance used to make things.
Name something you can wear that has a button, zipper or buckle.
questions.scope: Clothes, footwear, accessories and protective wear count.

questions.prompt: Name a quarterback who started and won a Super Bowl.
questions.scope: The quarterback must have started a winning Super Bowl, through Super Bowl LX in February 2026. Winning a ring as a backup alone does not count.

questions.prompt: Name an amusement park or theme-park resort.
questions.scope: Real parks and resort complexes count worldwide; familiar resort names would be accepted.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with metal music.
Name a type of creature from mythology, folklore, or fantasy.
Name a fat or oil used in cooking.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name an animal that is active at night.
questions.scope: Normally nocturnal or regularly night-active animals count; occasional unusual behavior does not.

questions.prompt: Name a type of room or specialized indoor space.
Name an athlete featured on a video game's cover or in its title.
questions.scope: An officially released sports game's cover athlete or title namesake qualifies.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Open World”.
